function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural roads, 45 mph on urban roads.
• 70 mph on interstate highways (except where posted otherwise).
• 65 mph on rural two‑lane highways. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Guidelines | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• No “seat‑belt law” for drivers over 18, but all passengers must buckle. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is illegal.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed.
• Texting while driving is prohibited. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for drivers 21+.
• Lower limits for commercial drivers (0.04 %) and drivers under 21 (0.02 %).
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• “Move‑over” law: vehicles must change lanes or slow down when approaching stopped emergency vehicles. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• Vehicles must stop on both sides of the road. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers.
• “No passing zone” signs prohibit overtaking. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or intersection.
• No parking in handicap spaces unless you have a valid permit. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Annual registration renewal required.
• Vehicle inspections required for certain vehicles (e.g., commercial). | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Toll Roads & Bridges** | • Texas has several toll roads (e.g., Sam Houston Tollway).
• Electronic toll collection (TxTag) is mandatory on many. | TxDOT Toll Operations | | **Special Provisions** | • “No‑stop” zones for construction.
• “High‑way speed limit” signs may override default limits. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT Website** – Traffic laws, road conditions, and updates. - **TxDMV** – Licensing, registration, and inspection requirements. - **Texas Transportation Code** – Full legal text (available online). ### Quick Tips for Drivers in Texas 1. **Always check posted speed limits** – they can vary widely. 2. **Keep your seat belt fastened** – it’s a legal requirement for all passengers. 3. **Avoid handheld phone use** – it’s a major cause of accidents. 4. **Be mindful of school buses** – stopping is mandatory. 5. **Know the “move‑over” rule** – it protects emergency workers. If you need more detailed information on a specific law or want to check the latest updates, let me know!
